newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER-DUTCH COACH HIDDINK HAS INTESTINAL OPERATION.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-DUTCH COACH HIDDINK HAS INTESTINAL OPERATION.

text.p: Dutch national soccer coach Guus Hiddink underwent a successful intestinal operation on Wednesday and is expected to make a speedy recovery, the Dutch news agency ANP said.

It was not yet clear whether Hiddink, who took charge in January 1995 and last year extended his contract to the 1998 World Cup, would be able to oversee Dutch preparations for their friendly against France on February 26, the agency said.
